GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311.23 (4 May 49) CCS
(SCAPIN - 2000/2)
APO 500
27 August 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Japanese Police Radio Stations.
1. Reference is made to:
a. SCAPIN 2000, dated 4 May 1949, subject: same as above.
b. SCAPIN 2000/1, dated 21 July 1949, subject: same as above.
2. The following paragraphs and subparagraphs of reference 1a above are hereby changed or rescinded as follows:
a. Paragraph 1a(1)(a) and 1a(1)(b) of Inclosure 1 thereto are rescinded.
b. Change paragraph 1a of Inclosure 3 thereto to read: "The operator in charge will be a second class operator and will inspect the equipment after movement before any transmissions are made."
c. Change paragraph 1b of Inclosure 3 thereto to read: "One third class operator will be assigned who may perform relief duties after the initial operation at any location."
d. Change paragraph 2b of Inclosure 3 thereto to read: "Equipment will be either fixed or portable provided a minimum of 150 portable sets are initially in operation. A portable station is defined as a station capable of being dismantled in one hour and installed in two hours.
In addition, it will be so packaged that two men can carry any component, except the emergency power unit, a short distance."
3. Direct communication among Civil Communications Section and Public Safety Division, G-2, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Ministry of Telecommunications and the National Rural Police on matters within the scope of this memorandum is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
